messages.content: Write the About page for a company that makes scheduling software for medical clinics. Around 250 words.

output:
# About Us

We build scheduling software for medical clinics, because the front desk shouldn't run on sticky notes and hold music.

Our founders spent years working inside clinic operations — one managed patient intake for a multi-site pediatric practice, another built internal tools for a hospital network before either had heard of Notion. They kept hitting the same wall: scheduling systems built for retail or restaurants, forced onto a workflow with insurance verification, provider licensing rules, recall reminders, and no-show patterns that actual clinics have to manage every day.

So we built something else. Our platform handles multi-provider calendars, automatic eligibility checks, patient reminders by text and email, and waitlist fill-ins that recover slots clinics used to lose. It connects to the EHR systems clinics already use, so staff aren't re-entering the same patient information three times before lunch.

We work with independent practices, urgent care groups, and specialty clinics across the country, from two-provider offices to networks with dozens of locations. Every clinic we work with told us the same thing during onboarding: they didn't want more software. They wanted fewer clicks, fewer double-bookings, and a front desk that isn't underwater by 10 a.m.

We're a small team, and we still talk to the people who use our product every week. When a clinic tells us their scheduling rules don't fit our system, we don't tell them to change their workflow. We build the feature.

If you run a clinic and your calendar feels like it's fighting you, we'd like to talk.
